visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with graying hair, wearing glasses and a black button-down shirt, stands centrally in a professional studio. He gestures actively with both hands while speaking. The background consists of a bookshelf and warm, focused studio lighting. (2) A white text box overlay titled 'Flood Protecting Standard' in Chinese and English appears to the right of the man. He continues his presentation, maintaining eye contact with the camera and using precise hand movements to emphasize points. (3) An image of a famous Japanese idol, Kanna Hashimoto, in a sailor-style school uniform performing a 'thousand-year' dance pose is shown as a centered overlay. The speaker remains in the studio, looking at the camera. (4) The visual switches to an aerial drone-style shot of a village heavily flooded with brown, muddy water. Only rooftops and trees are visible above the surface, illustrating a natural disaster scenario in a rural setting. (5) Gameplay footage from a turn-based RPG is displayed, showing characters attacking a monster with floating damage numbers and 'Critical' and '1%' labels. This serves as a visual metaphor for statistical chance in gaming. (6) A short clip of a crane machine filled with iPhone boxes appears. A mechanical claw attempts to grab a prize, representing the concept of 'guaranteed win' vs. luck. The man returns to full-frame studio narration. (7) A screenshot of the 'World Weather Attribution' website is shown with several news headlines about extreme rainfall. Red highlights appear on specific text sections as the narrator discusses global climate change research findings. (8) B-roll footage depicts a white car partially submerged in a fast-moving muddy flood and workers wearing high-visibility yellow vests standing near a large concrete flood barrier. The lighting is natural and overcast outdoors. (9) A cinematic wide-angle shot shows a massive supercell storm cloud formation over a plain at dusk. The dark, swirling clouds represent the 'Ultimate Boss' of nature. The man is seen gesturing in front of this image. (10) The speaker returns to the studio for his closing remarks, speaking with a serious and sincere expression. A logo for the 'Water Resources Agency' appears as a permanent overlay at the bottom.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 原來我們一直誤會的水利科學 No 1. (2) [Subtitle]: 不是我們的防禦變弱了. (3) [Subtitle]: 而是老天爺把他的暴擊率從百年一遇調整成十年一遇. (4) [Subtitle]: 為了防禦老天爺的暴擊，在水利工程上有個專有名詞. (5) [Subtitle]: 叫保護標準. [Variety]: Flood Protecting Standard. (6) [Subtitle]: 通常會用重現期距作為設計依據. (7) [Subtitle]: 也就是我們經常聽到的百年一遇或兩百年週期. (8) [Subtitle]: 蛤你說千年一遇美少女. (9) [Subtitle]: 水利工程沒管那麼寬. (10) [Subtitle]: 但百年一遇不是百年發生一次，而是在任何一年. (11) [Subtitle]: 都有百分之一的機率會發生那麼大規模的洪水. (12) [Subtitle]: 這就像在遊戲裡打怪，你的暴擊率是 1%. (13) [Subtitle]: 不是你打一百下才爆一下. (14) [Subtitle]: 又不是夾娃娃還可以保夾. (15) [Subtitle]: 而是你每次攻擊都得跟系統賭，賭那百分之一的機率. (16) [Subtitle]: 而在全球暖化加劇氣候變遷的今天，情況變得更棘手了. (17) [Subtitle]: 根據氣候研究機構 World Weather Attribution 世界天氣歸因. [Logo]: World Weather Attribution. (18) [Subtitle]: 針對各地致災性暴雨的個案研究，許多地區的暴雨強度都比過去還強. (19) [Subtitle]: 發生的頻率比過去還高. (20) [Subtitle]: 相當於老天爺這個 Boss 在每次地球 online 的更新中. (21) [Subtitle]: 都被持續 Buff. (22) [Subtitle]: 他的暴擊率從 1% 上調到 10%. (23) [Subtitle]: 過去理論上的百年一遇，現在可能是十年一遇. (24) [Subtitle]: 而我們的防洪標準是用過去長年的數據計算出來的統計結果. (25) [Subtitle]: 它能幫助我們防禦絕大多數的普通攻擊跟小暴擊. (26) [Subtitle]: 但統計學最難預測的就是那些機率極小，傷害卻夭壽大的黑天鵝事件. (27) [Subtitle]: 當一場雨就能帶來四倍百年一遇的水量還夾帶超多泥沙時. (28) [Subtitle]: 我們現有的防禦體系該如何應付呢. (29) [Subtitle]: 欸對我們不可能無止盡的提高保護標準. (30) [Subtitle]: 也沒有任何標準能保證絕對安全. (31) [Subtitle]: 因為在大自然這個終極 Boss 面前，總有我們算不到的暴擊來打臉. (32) [Subtitle]: 我們能做的就是理解風險，並為那個萬一做好萬全準備. (33) [Logo]: 經濟部水利署.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The narrator begins with a clear, professional tone and moderate pitch, supported by a rhythmic electronic background track. A digital 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the appearance of the first subtitle block. The mix is clean, with the voice prominently seated above the BGM. (2) As the narrator explains the 'protection standard' concept, his speech rate remains steady and articulate. Frequent soft 'pop' sound effects signal the transition between on-screen text elements. The background music maintains a constant 4/4 electronic pulse with no external noise. (3) A sharp, high-pitched 'ding' sound effect occurs when the photo of the Japanese idol is shown. The speaker's tone becomes more playful and energetic, with higher pitch variability. The electronic music continues uninterrupted, providing a cohesive energy to the technical explanation. (4) The narrator's voice adopts a more serious and informative quality while discussing flood data and global warming. The audio master is pristine, with high spectral brightness and no technical artifacts. The background track lowers slightly in volume to ensure maximum clarity of the verbal data. (5) Fast-paced digital sound effects, resembling video game UI, are layered over the narrator's voice during the RPG metaphor section. The speaker uses high arousal and confidence. The segment ends with a final musical fade and a soft stinger sound effect as the agency logo appears.
